findings.summary: whale_swap normalization violates invariant by copying the input direction instead of deriving it from solDelta and usdcDelta, and its tests are fake-passing by only asserting eventType.
findings.suggested_fix: In `normalize.ts`, inside the `whale_swap` case, calculate `direction` by checking `wsEvent.solDelta` and `wsEvent.usdcDelta` (e.g., if solDelta > 0 and usdcDelta < 0 return "buy_sol", else if solDelta < 0 and usdcDelta > 0 return "sell_sol", else "unknown"). Also update `tests/domain/on-chain-flow/normalize.test.ts` to actually assert `expect(result.direction).toBe("buy_sol")` instead of just checking `eventType`.
